verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own marketing states that it uses AI to declutter feedback and find the most impactful opportunities, which matches the story directly. That single line is the only evidence: nothing describes how the AI works, such as deduplication, clustering, summarization or impact ranking. Missing for 10: documentation of the AI decluttering mechanism (merging or deduplicating similar feedback), documentation of how opportunities are scored or prioritized by impact, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI to declutter raw feedback and surface the most impactful opportunities

citations.quote: Featurebase helps you declutter & find the most impactful opportunities with AI.
